_note: sync-v2 §8.3 step 1 / §14 phase 5 producer, tag half (the target set is cards AND tags). Drives the website's tag-proposal seam (proposeTagSave / proposeTagDelete / proposeSetCardTags → ingestProposals) against a scratch DB and pins that a website-UI tag edit becomes an inbox row the app's card-tag command can apply VERBATIM: kind/op/object_id parity (card_tag_save/upsert/object=payload.uuid; card_tag_delete/delete/object=payload.tag_uuid; card_set_tags/upsert/object=payload.card_uuid), payload == the serialized Tag / {tag_uuid} / {card_uuid, tag_uuids[]}, and the whole SET rather than a delta (a partial list silently erases the omitted tags). The same-host oracle is `objectIdFor`/`opFor`/`changeClassOf` — what this host's own journal reader derives from each payload must agree with what the seam put on the wire. Also proves INV-6 canonical edit_time, INV-3 change_id dedup with no proposal_seq gap, INV-1 (no journal row minted) and INV-17 (catalog byte-unchanged). The producer is proposal-only — it never writes live/.
